correctness.rationale: For every finite absorbing/reflecting chain and sampled-rate exponent 0<alpha<=1, conditioning on a rate interval and renewing proves the exact matrix spectral multiplier. The physical-time correction is a substochastic fractional resolvent integral bounded in [0,tau alpha/(1+alpha)]. The mixed discrete sine eigenbasis and source-vector sums are verified algebraically. Integrable Riemann sums, dominated odd-mode series, and the uniform near-critical singular integral give respectively bounded, logarithmic, power and crossover regimes. Independent finite generator diagonalization and limiting numerical tests pass; finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: A sharply divergent half-line MFPT is not directly realizable on finite apparatus. The exact rounded scaling at fixed starting site, three universal regimes, logarithmic critical amplitude and explicit scaling profile alpha=1/2+u/log N resolve a physically natural finite-volume question. The uniform renewal correction certifies that rate-refresh timing cannot alter leading finite-size exponents or amplitudes. The result is not a standalone arbitrary numerical invariant.
